chain.label: ATSV-air filter cleaning/inspection procedure not properly performed
chain.trigger: American Airlines' maintenance personnel did not clean the accident ATSV-air filter in accordance with its C check cleaning procedures

chain.label: Undetected fatigue/fretting damage in ATSV-air filter
chain.trigger: fatigue and fretting damage...had developed over a long period of time...clearly visible to the naked eye when the filter element was removed

caused_by.evidence: missed an opportunity to identify and replace the damaged filter

chain.label: Filter disintegration blocks airflow, engine no-start
chain.trigger: the filter element of the ATSV-air filter disintegrated, allowing the end cap to become free, which blocked the air flow and caused the engine no-start condition

caused_by.evidence: filter element disintegrated, allowing the end cap to become free, which blocked the air flow

chain.label: CASS program deficiencies
chain.trigger: American Airlines' CASS program did not adequately detect and correct these performance deficiencies before they contributed to an accident

chain.label: Maintenance used unapproved manual engine-start procedure
chain.trigger: maintenance personnel repeatedly used an unapproved maintenance procedure, which included using a prying device to push the ATSV manual override button

caused_by.evidence: troubleshooting efforts for the engine no-start condition incorrectly focused on the ATSV and engine start system wiring
CASS program did not adequately detect and correct these performance deficiencies

chain.label: ATSV override button internal pin bent
chain.trigger: using the prying device resulted in bending the button's internal pin, which prevented the ball valve from sealing completely

caused_by.evidence: resulted in bending the internal pin in the override button

chain.label: ATSV opens uncommanded, ATS freewheels and fails
chain.trigger: the ATSV opened uncommanded during high-power engine conditions at the beginning of the takeoff roll and caused the ATS to freewheel until it sustained a catastrophic internal failure

caused_by.evidence: bent manual override pin...prevented the ball valve from sealing completely...causing the ATSV to open uncommanded

chain.label: Left engine fire
chain.trigger: the open ATSV and resulting failed ATS allowed a hotter than typical airstream and/or incandescent particles to flow into the engine nacelle area and likely provided the ignition source for the in-flight fire

caused_by.evidence: allowed a hotter than typical airstream and/or incandescent particles...likely provided the ignition source

chain.label: Crew interrupts fire checklist for nonessential tasks
chain.trigger: the captain transferred control of the airplane to the first officer...to brief the flight attendants

caused_by.evidence: Left Engine Fire warning light illuminated, and...the first officer began performing the Engine Fire/Damage/Separation checklist

chain.label: Prolonged fire damages hydraulic system, pressure lost
chain.trigger: pilots' interruption of the emergency Engine Fire/Damage/Separation checklist at a critical point prolonged the fire and led to additional problems, including the loss of hydraulic pressure

caused_by.evidence: prolonged the fire and led to additional problems, including the loss of hydraulic pressure

chain.label: Nose landing gear fails to extend
chain.trigger: loss of hydraulic pressure...caused the nose landing gear to fail to extend

caused_by.evidence: loss of hydraulic pressure, which caused the nose landing gear to fail to extend

chain.label: Go-around and emergency landing with manual gear extension
chain.trigger: the flight crew executed a go-around, during which the crew extended the nose gear using the emergency procedure. The flight crew conducted an emergency landing

caused_by.evidence: nose landing gear failed to extend, and the flight crew executed a go-around

chain.label: Inadequate guidance on crossfeed valve/fire handle link
chain.trigger: American Airlines' manuals and training did not indicate that opening the crossfeed valve causes the fire handle to retract, reversing the shutoff of fuel

chain.label: First officer opens crossfeed valve for cabin air
chain.trigger: the first officer opened the left pneumatic crossfeed valve to improve the airflow in the cabin

caused_by.evidence: first officer did not have a clear understanding of the relationship...most likely because of inadequate company guidance and training

chain.label: Fire handle retracts, fuel reintroduced and dumps overboard
chain.trigger: which caused the left engine fire handle to retract and fuel to flow into the damaged engine area...fuel was dumping from the left engine

caused_by.evidence: caused the left engine fire handle to retract and fuel to be reintroduced to the left engine area

chain.label: Passengers deplaned without injury; aircraft substantially damaged
chain.trigger: the 2 flight crewmembers, 3 flight attendants, and 138 passengers deplaned on the runway. No occupant injuries were reported, but the airplane sustained substantial damage from the fire

caused_by.evidence: flight crew conducted an emergency landing
ARFF personnel noticed that fuel was dumping from the left engine and, therefore, recommended that the passengers be deplaned
